mapper.select: SELECT id, organization_id, user_id, member_id, title, channel, status, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at, version FROM assistant_conversation WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{conversationId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, organization_id, user_id, member_id, title, channel, status, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at, version FROM assistant_conversation WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND (member_id = #{memberId} OR member_id IS NULL) ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, created_at) DESC, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_conversation ( id, organization_id, user_id, member_id, title, channel, status, last_message_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationId}, #{userId}, #{memberId}, #{title}, #{channel}, 'OPEN', #{now}, #{now}, #{now} )

INSERT INTO assistant_message ( id, organization_id, conversation_id, role, content, reasoning_summary, tool_traces, data, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationId}, #{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{reasoningSummary}, CAST(#{toolTracesJson} AS jsonb), #{data,typeHandler=com.yourcompany.salesagent.shared.persistence.JsonbMapTypeHandler}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, organization_id, conversation_id, role, content, reasoning_summary, tool_traces::text AS tool_traces_json, data, created_at FROM assistant_message WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
